turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you one first: Tom ___ (eat) rice every day.
Step 1: who is it? Tom, so he. Step 2: after he, the verb needs an ending. Step 3: eat becomes eats. Result: Tom eats rice every day.
The rule: after he, she or it, add -s or -es to the verb.
Right: She reads every night. Wrong: She read every night.
Now you. Write only the verb.
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
